test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the set of words best represented by the given Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d08c5a93e42a2c1e4c18e4804a75331ddbd350ec9cd87d92fea06817bae378f.png]
solution:
The set of words that best represented by the given Venn diagram is shown below:

1) Jasmine, Flowers, Eggs - As Jasmine is one of the types of flower, there Jasmine will be inside the flowers. Eggs is food is not related to flowers or Jasmine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13936435b1104e7e47a645f6afd3b40a88f44da6afc5433f1553379a48ccbe2a.png] 

2) Water, Liquid, Juice - Water and Juice are the types of liquid , therefore both water and juice will come inside the liquid ⇒ Option - 2 eliminated

3) Roses, Lilies, Flowers - Roses and lilies are the types of flowers, therefore both roses and lilies will come inside flowers ⇒ Option - 3 eliminated

4) Maize, Rice, Food - Maize and rice are the types of food, therefore both maize and rice will come inside food ⇒ Option - 4 eliminated

Hence, **"Jasmine, Flowers, Eggs"** is the correct answer.
